lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A non-uniform grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters distributed across the visible mid-section posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like anchor pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A clear distribution of high-luminance blobs bounded within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, matching the spatial frequency of the adjacent flank patterns.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct high-contrast elongated silhouettes (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral region of the subject.
